name: Pillersee
kurzbeschreibung: The Pillersee in St. Ulrich at 835 m altitude: emerald-green mountain lake in the Pillerseetal, circular trail, stand-up paddling, and backdrop of the Loferer Steinberge.
beschreibung:
Overview

The picturesque Pillersee lies at an elevation of 835 meters, nestled in the eponymous Pillerseetal in the municipality of St. Ulrich am Pillersee in the Kitzbühel district. With a surface area of nearly 0.25 square kilometers and a maximum depth of around seven meters, this shimmering emerald-green body of water forms the scenic centerpiece of the entire region. Fed by crystal-clear mountain streams descending from the rugged Loferer Steinberge and the Kitzbüheler Alpen, the lake enchants nature lovers, walkers, and water sports enthusiasts with its idyllic shoreline landscape and rich flora and fauna.

Nature, Swimming Fun & Circular Lake Trail

The lake was formed roughly 15,000 years ago at the end of the last Ice Age by a massive landslide from the slopes of the Loferer Steinberge, which dammed the valley's outflow. The water of the Pillersee is renowned for its exceptional purity and alpine freshness: even in midsummer, water temperatures rarely exceed 19 to 20 °C, ensuring a deliciously invigorating swim on hot summer days. Along the eastern shore, a well-tended sunbathing lawn with gently sloping gravel beaches provides an ideal spot for families with children. A boat rental station offers rowboats, pedal boats, and stand-up paddleboards (SUP) for gliding quietly across the glassy surface. A premier highlight for walkers is the roughly 5.5-kilometer Pillersee-Rundwanderweg: this almost completely level circuit takes about 1.5 hours to circumnavigate the lake. Information boards along the way illuminate protected wet meadows, rare bird species such as great crested grebes and grey herons, and the lake's thriving trout population. On the southern shore, the historic 15th-century Adolari-Kirchlein chapel attracts cultural visitors.

Visit & Getting There

The Pillersee and its lakeshore walking trails are freely accessible and free of charge year-round. Access to the open sunbathing areas along the shore is complimentary (changing facilities and sanitary facilities are available along the lakeside promenade). The boat rental operates seasonally from late May to late September in good weather, daily from 10:00 to 18:00. By car: via the B164 to Fieberbrunn or St. Johann in Tirol, continuing on the Pillersee provincial road L2 to St. Ulrich am Pillersee; parking is available along the lakeside promenade and by the restaurant Seewirt (partially subject to fees). By public transport: ÖBB train to Hochfilzen or Fieberbrunn station, then regional bus line 4012 directly to the stop St. Ulrich am Pillersee Ort or See.

Tips

The entire circular trail around the Pillersee is wide, surfaced with fine compacted gravel, and fully barrier-free for strollers and wheelchair users. Dine at the traditional restaurant Seewirt right on the northern shore to enjoy freshly caught Pillersee trout on the lakeside terrace, taking in direct views across the water and the sheer limestone walls of the Steinberge.
